XenotypeDef.label: devil bug
XenotypeDef.description: A cockroach-like insect mamono of dark, damp places, and the lowest rung of the hive. She builds and mends the walls her sisters live in and hauls what they leave behind, and they treat her as little more than a household pest - which is exactly what she is. She does not mind the work, and she does not stop.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A cockroach-like drudge who raises and mends the hive's walls.

XenotypeDef.label: giant ant
XenotypeDef.description: A worker caste mamono of the deep nests. Honest and diligent, she digs through solid rock and carries loads larger than herself without complaint - though the pheromones in her sweat grow heavier the harder she works.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A diligent, strong insect mamono born to dig and haul.

XenotypeDef.label: soldier beetle
XenotypeDef.description: Heavy cavalry from birth. Her exoskeleton turns aside swords and arrows, and her carapace grows one of three killing tools - ripper-blades, charger claws or a megaspider horn. Calm, obedient and nearly expressionless - until she chooses a man to escort.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: An armoured, obedient insect mamono, slow and hard to hurt, who grows one of three weapons.

XenotypeDef.label: greenworm
XenotypeDef.description: A soft-bodied, gentle mamono who loves nothing more than eating. She eats her hive out of house and home, and one day she spins a cocoon and comes out a papillon.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A soft, gentle insect mamono who eats far more than her sisters.

XenotypeDef.label: vamp mosquito
XenotypeDef.description: The vampire of the insect world. Cunning and mean, she stalks her prey on buzzing wings and strikes when their guard drops. Her bite carries a venom that makes the wound hot and throbbing - and only her touch soothes it. She drinks blood most greedily in her lover's arms.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A winged, blood-drinking insect mamono with a venomous bite.

XenotypeDef.label: abaddon
XenotypeDef.description: Daughter of the bug mamono lord who nearly devoured the world in antiquity. Quiet and spacey rather than ferocious, but her appetite - and her fertility - are without limit. Her pheromones command the swarm, her wingbeats shake the heavens, and once she devotes herself to a man it is for life.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A sleepless queen mamono of limitless appetite and fertility.

XenotypeDef.label: abaddon folk
XenotypeDef.description: One of the countless soldier bugs of an abaddon's swarm. Petite where her queen is vast, she is built for the swarm rather than for herself: she reads the swarm's orders in the pheromones in the air, shares her sisters' endless hunger for jelly, and once she has a man for her own she tends him as calmly and as constantly as she tends her post.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A petite soldier bug of the abaddon swarm, who lives by pheromones.

XenotypeDef.label: arachne
XenotypeDef.description: A weaver of the deep dark, patient and cruel, with eight legs and a silk sac.

XenotypeDef.label: beelzebub
XenotypeDef.description: A lord of gluttony among the swarm's flies: tiny, quick, magically potent and always hungry.

XenotypeDef.label: girtablilu
XenotypeDef.description: An assassin of the desert: scorpion-shelled, pincer-handed and always ready to charge, with a sting's worth of venom in her claws.

XenotypeDef.label: ant arachne
XenotypeDef.description: A small arachne disguised as a giant ant, living in the ants' own nest. Her hands are made for building, and the silk she spins is the same silk her bigger sister sells.

XenotypeDef.label: honey bee
XenotypeDef.description: A honey bee mamono, round and soft and never still. She keeps the hive's crops and its beasts, humming to herself the whole time, and her body slowly fills with honey as she works. She is happiest doing exactly that, and there is little behind her eyes but the next row and the next animal.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A cheerful, tireless farmer whose body fills with honey.

XenotypeDef.label: mothman
XenotypeDef.description: A mothman mamono, soft and dusty-winged and never quite awake. She keeps to the dark until a lamp is lit, and then she cannot leave it - the light leaves her a little dazed and very happy. She will not fight anyone, and she is the best company in the village.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A drowsy, gentle moth woman who loves lamp light and cannot fight.

XenotypeDef.label: papillon
XenotypeDef.description: A papillon mamono, bright-winged and soft-bodied, and the frailest of her sisters. Violence is not in her at all; what is in her is a quick mind and a quicker heart, in a village that mostly has neither. Everyone likes her, and she has never once been surprised by that.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A beautiful, fragile butterfly woman who cannot fight and learns fast.

XenotypeDef.label: hornet
XenotypeDef.description: A hornet mamono, long-legged and banded in yellow and black, and angry in a way the rest of the hive is not. She fights for honey she cannot make and hates the bee who makes it - the smell of a honey bee is enough to set her off.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A quick, bad-tempered wasp woman who fights for the hive and cannot stand honey bees.

XenotypeDef.label: mantis
XenotypeDef.description: A mantis mamono of the swarm: long-limbed, green, with ripper blades folded into her arms. She hunts to kill and feels nothing for the woman in front of her, and she is too thin-shelled to take a blow in return.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A cold, thin-shelled killer with blades folded into her arms.
